import { defineTable, col } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - the many-to-many with customers through customer_customer_demo is declared on customers only: declaring it here too would re-key customer_customer_demo from (customer_id, customer_type_id).
export const customerDemographics = defineTable("customer_demographics", {
    columns: {
        customerTypeId: col.varchar(5).primaryKey(),
        customerDesc: col.text()
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
